# lz4 / compress_fuzzer

lz4's own fuzz target `compress_fuzzer` ([source](source/compress_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over lz4 (lz4/lz4 at 0774d055).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: LZ4_compress_default into a fuzzed capacity in [0, LZ4_compressBound]; if it returns >0, LZ4_decompress_safe must regenerate exactly size bytes equal to the input.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against lz4 at commit 0774d055.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- LZ4_compress_default into a fuzzed capacity in [0, LZ4_compressBound]; if it returns >0, LZ4_decompress_safe must regenerate exactly size bytes equal to the input ([lines 46-55](source/compress_fuzzer.c#L46-L55)): abort(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch lz4` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `compress_fuzzer.plain` | 61,736 | `c3c1200d0f0ee383bb321edb7f1519f31964cfdf244b3808a3cb87f4d6abbf34` |
| ubsan | `compress_fuzzer.ubsan` | 67,120 | `70c9726d5ecacb1b7d4ded4e7494f9b01336ca2768449db41edd0d8ea021186b` |
| asan | `compress_fuzzer.asan` | 602,968 | `c54f3ea3e8aa568c7daf02fd52db1119ecfc476cecef7d16cccbfa509be20522` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
